notes.title: Update Log v1.5.0 - 2025/9/11​​
notes.content:
Added temporary resource display for levels and optimized layout.
 Fixed leaderboard display issues.
 Fixed memory crystal quest level display issues.
 Fixed character movement experience issues after opening the leaderboard from the attributes interface.
 Fixed other experience issues.
 NPC interaction dialogues now only appear during the first interaction to avoid repetition.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.4.7 - 2025/9/8
notes.content:
Fixed an issue preventing the perfect ending from being achieved.
 Added a daily check-in reward system.

notes.title: Changelog v1.4.1 - 2025/9/1
notes.content:
Fixed the issue preventing completion of Level 2-1

 Fixed timer issues during Speed Trials when using a controller.

Added two new achievements: Gold-Attracting Stone and Scouting Stone.

Fixed an issue where buttons appeared when clicking incomplete achievements.

notes.title: Update Log v1.4.0 - 2025/8/28
notes.content:
Fixed the issue of no data in the leaderboard.  
 Fixed the issue where the Speed Trial could not be completed.

notes.title: Update Log v1.3.9 - 2025/8/25
notes.content:
Added success probability and obtainable values for equipment enhancement.
 Attempted to fix the issue reported by some players where the game becomes unresponsive upon startup.

notes.title: Update Log v1.3.8 - 2025/8/25
notes.content:
Fixed occasional duplicate completion prompts for quests or achievements.  
 	Resolved an issue where the Level Leaderboard required Level 11 to enter.  
 	Optimized the time display format in leaderboards.  
 	Improved screen shake issues in the game's background.  
 	Added keyboard and controller support for probing magic stones.  
 	Enhanced the level flow experience in the Speed Trial mode.  
 	Added Steam Leaderboard support.  
 	Fixed conflicts between the rename input box and certain shortcut keys.

notes.title: Update Log v1.3.7 - 2025/8/21​​
notes.content:
Added smooth animation effects to hero health and mana bars.
 Added smooth animation and flash-on-hit effects to the BOSS health bar.
 Fixed an issue with damage number display.

notes.title: Update Log v1.3.6 - 2025/8/21​​
notes.content:
• Optimized Tips display effect
• Improved interface details in Speed Trial mode
• Enhanced gold amount display (shows 2 decimal places when exceeding 1K)
• Fixed an issue where players couldn't exit after collecting treasure chests in Level 1-5
